value: For a habitual and permanent home the deposit may not exceed two months' rent; a bank guarantee or other agreed guarantee may replace it (Art. 14.1).

value: The landlord must return the deposit at the end of the lease on receiving the keys, unless it is applied, with supporting documents, to unpaid obligations or damage; the claim to recover it lapses three years after the lease ends (Art. 14.3-14.4).

value: Unless agreed otherwise, rent is paid monthly within the first five days of each month; the landlord may not demand more than one month's rent in advance and must always give a receipt (Art. 20).

value: A lease of a habitual and permanent home may not be shorter than five years; a shorter or open-ended lease is treated as five years if the tenant so wishes (Art. 42.1-42.2).

value: After the minimum term the lease is tacitly renewed for one-year periods unless either party gives at least three months' notice before the end of the term or a renewal (Art. 42.3).

value: The tenant may end the lease before the agreed term with one month's notice; without that notice the tenant owes one month's rent for each year left to run (Art. 18).
